purpose: Exploratory test of pair-loss imbalance, not confirmation of spatial maps
ridge: Unchanged pointwise coordinate regression; balancing applies only to metric probes
selection: Validation 180-degree comparisons only. Retrieval: maximize accuracy then minimize distance MAE. Geometry: minimize distance MAE then maximize accuracy.
controls: consistent permutation of training site coordinates (preserves identity)
interpretation: Compare matched arms, not the best test score across arms. Confirmation requires fresh routes and held-out locations.
